September 6, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-6-1971-54679

A team of freedom fighters led by Lt Colonel Anwar set anti-tank mines, gelignite and plastic explosives on Mogolhat rail tracks in Sector No. 6. A train embarked with Pak troops is destroyed due to the blast. Five raiders are killed in the attack.

Martial court in Dhaka orders 48 provincial assembly members to appear before it.

Peace Committee member Shahid Ali calls for an assembly in Sylhet chaired by Brigadier Iftekhar Ahmad Rana. Rana presents certificates to Razakars – Adam Mia, Osman Goni and Abdur Rahman – signed by General Tikka Khan. Haripur is named aafter deceased Razakar Talat’s name, as Talat Nagar.
